cohort: 250 women diagnosed with eclampsia at Minia Maternity University Hospital, Egypt between January 2013 and December 2014
finding: Morbidity and mortality from eclampsia were high, with a case fatality rate of 1.6% and perinatal death rate of 11.9%, and associated with young age, nulliparity, low education level, poor antenatal care, and pre-existing medical conditions.
mod_finding: 46 cases (18.4%) had vaginal delivery, 22 (8.8%) had assisted delivery, and 177 (70.8%) had cesarean sections (151 primary and 26 intrapartum).
